Hi Samantha / Michael —

Thanks for a productive call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same signal. I tried to call out the concrete integration asks we heard and how Redwood would recommend approaching them.

Key pain points you described
- Search precision: existing QA assistant returns too many false positives for similar clinical notes.
- Latency spikes during batch exports (peak hours), causing UI timeouts for clinicians.
- Difficulty producing structured, auditable summaries for compliance and downstream billing flows.

Goals we heard
1) Reduce incorrect matches in diagnostic suggestion reranking by 20–30% after rerank layer.
2) Keep 95th percentile token latency under 350ms for interactive clinician flows.
3) Produce structured JSON summaries conforming to your BillingSchema v2 for audit.

Proposed technical fit (high level)
- Embeddings + reranking: run a small candidate generator (existing BM25 + small embed candidate sample) and send top-50 to Redwood reranker. We recommend the embed.ranking-2 model (quantized) for cost balance; pilot on a 100k-utterance set.
- Streaming + function calls: for clinician assistant we suggest streaming partial structured output while the model finalizes remaining sections (reduces perceived latency). Use function-calling for final BillingSchema v2 validation step so the output is strongly typed.
- SDK change: you asked for a lightweight client-side hook to invalidate KV cache for a patient session when upstream EHR syncs; we can expose a single-call API (redwood.sdk.cache.invalidate(session_id)) in the next minor release.

Attachments included
- qcare-integration-scope-v1.pdf: proposed milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria.
- example-prod-utterances.csv: anonymized sample we discussed for initial eval.
- redwood-funcall-schema.yaml: suggested function call schema for BillingSchema v2 enforcement.

Action items / owners (proposed)
- QuantumCare: provide a 1k–5k sample of anonymized clinician utterances (Michael) — due: 2026-12-03.
- Redwood: spin up rerank pilot dataset and share evaluation script + baseline metrics (Ben) — due: 2026-12-07.
- Joint: 45-min technical working session to walk through function-call schema and streaming behavior (schedule link below) — proposed week of 2026-12-06 (Priyom to coordinate).

Ask: Can you confirm Michael will share the sample by 12/03 and whether compliance needs a separate DSAR process?

Thanks again — short next steps will let us get a quick Eval in under two weeks.

—
